task.description: Design and add comprehensive tests for IDN-01 user registry implementation. Create/update test spec(s) and concrete tests covering create-user success (201 with platform-assigned user_id and created_at), duplicate username conflict (409), invalid email (422), rejection of caller-provided user_id/created_at, INACTIVE status behavior in auth path (401), and allowed create with status INACTIVE. Ensure tests are wired to existing test suites and compatible with repository conventions.
acceptance_criteria: A test spec for IDN-01 exists and maps all acceptance criteria
Automated tests for happy path and required error cases are implemented
Auth-path test coverage verifies INACTIVE users receive 401
No placeholder or always-skip tests added
zig build test compiles with new tests

result.summary: Test specs and automated tests for IDN-01 were added: create-user success (201 with platform-assigned user_id/created_at), duplicate username conflict (409), invalid email (422), rejection of caller-provided user_id/created_at (422), INACTIVE create allowed (201), and auth-path rejection for INACTIVE user tokens (401).
